Survey the codebase and write a plan for making `defaultModel` a per-session setting (each `.pi-session` file carries its own model preference, overriding global default).

| `buildSessionContext` derives model from `model_change` entries | `session-manager.ts:362-376` — confirmed, scans path for `model_change` type entries | ✅ |

| `model-selector` writes to global settings | `model-selector.ts:367` — confirmed, calls `setDefaultModelAndProvider` | ✅ |
